decisions.reason: Identifies fs-ext@2.1.1 from dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, its node-gyp configure build install script, and missing Visual Studio/MSVC as the failure cause.
Explains that --ignore-scripts leaves the native entry unloadable and that the top-level fs-ext import loads before Windows runtime branch selection.
Distinguishes Windows named kernel semaphore locking from POSIX flock, allowing an import-safe Windows stub while preserving real flock on Linux/macOS.
Follows the pnpm patchedDependencies precedent to guard fs-ext's install and entry on win32, register the patch and build permissions, and verify reinstall, module load, and service boot.
Respects the owner's no-Visual-Studio constraint and uses a repository-managed local patch rather than requiring upstream dependency changes.
Cites DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 and connects it directly to the fs-ext Windows install failure and local patch plan.

caps.reason: The plan explicitly avoids installing Visual Studio/MSVC.
The plan rejects ignore-scripts-only and makes the statically imported entry loadable.
The plan uses repository-managed pnpm patching rather than upstream edits or releases.
The plan keeps Windows semaphore locking and POSIX flock; the Windows fs-ext no-op is only for an unused static import path.
